questions.questionText: On a tree, there are some parrots and some pigeons in the ratio of 7 : 9, respectively. questions.solution: According to the official TCS answer key, the correct option is (C).

questions.questionText: In an examination, the number of students who passed and the number of students who failed were in the ratio 25: 4. questions.solution: According to the official TCS answer key, the correct option is (B).

questions.solution: According to the official TCS answer key, the correct option is (D).

questions.solution: According to the official TCS answer key, the correct option is (C).

questions.solution: According to the official TCS answer key, the correct option is (A).

questions.solution: According to the official TCS answer key, the correct option is (D).
